query: SELECT activity.message_id AS "message_id!: String" FROM board_activity activity WHERE ((activity.root_id=? AND activity.kind='threadMessageCreated') OR (activity.message_id=? AND activity.kind='mainMessageCreated')) AND activity.message_id IS NOT NULL AND activity.actor_key<>? AND activity.activity_sequence>? ORDER BY activity.activity_sequence ASC LIMIT ?
